family: The single total BK/Shoup family defined in proof.md: f_0=0; for n>=1 choose the least prime k>2*n^(3/5), r=ceil(n/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)); fix one deterministic Shoup F_2 irreducible-polynomial algorithm; pad x with zeros into r field blocks, set y_i=phi_i(x)^(2^(i+1)-1), and output the constant coefficient of Sym_r^t(y_1,...,y_r). The fixed algorithm and field basis are as specified in proof.md.
theorem: For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, for every integer n>=1, C_B2(f_n)>=4n-10*d(n) with d(n)=floor(6*n^(4/5))+1, and therefore C_B2(f_n)>=4n-60*n^(4/5)-10, at actual input length n=|x| in the full Li-Yang B2 model. Hence liminf C_B2(f_n)/n>=4.
